channel.title: Taimour Nazir — investigations & notes
channel.description: Investigation walkthroughs, detections mapped to MITRE ATT&CK, and notes on the journey.

item.title: Detecting a password spray that never trips a lockout
item.description: The naive 4625 threshold misses this entirely. The fix is to stop counting per account and start counting per source — then chain it to what happens next.

item.title: Quarter close: phishing to token theft to Kerberoasting
item.description: A constructed enterprise incident worked end to end — including the two dead ends that ate twenty minutes and the pivot most analysts stop short of.

item.title: Building a home SOC: what six months of lab reps actually taught me
item.description: Four VMs, two SIEMs running in parallel, and one rule — hunt cold before you look up the answer.
